I purchased this to add to our kitchen storage space especially for appliances like a mixer, crock pot, etc. It matches our kitchen cabinets and we also have a butcher block table. My son and husband put it together in less than 1 1/2 hours. Hubby handed the necessary tools and the pieces and hardware to him and our son put it together. They did not have any issues in the process. I am very happy with it.

It's perfect! Much better than I could have hoped for! Counter space in my kitchen is at a premium and I desperately needed something for my canner and foodie. If you have experience putting these things together it's not difficult, but might be challenging for someone that doesn't have a lot of experience. Everything lined up perfectly and there was even extra hardware which is always a plus! Also, major props for how well it was packed, UPS was not kind and I was worried about damage but it was so well padded and packed that everything was still in perfect condition!
